messages.content: my service canada account log in

message.content:
**My Service Canada Account (MSCA)** sign-in is available through the Government of Canada account page, and you must use the same sign-in method you used when you registered, such as **GCKey**, **Interac® Sign-In Partner**, or a **provincial sign-in**.[2][5]

If you are trying to log in:
- Go to the **My Service Canada Account** sign-in page.[2]
- Choose the sign-in option you originally registered with.[2]
- If you want to use a different sign-in method, you’ll need to register for that option separately.[2]

If you have not registered yet:
- You may need an **Access Code** to register.[1][3]
- Registration can be done with **GCKey**, your **bank sign-in**, or a **provincial sign-in** if you live in an eligible province.[1][2][4]

If you’re having trouble:
- Service Canada says to contact **1 800 O-Canada** for other inquiries.[2]

If you want, I can also give you the **exact steps to sign in with GCKey** or help you figure out **which login option you used before**.
